gloss: to copy; to duplicate; to reproduce

definitions.gloss: to copy; to duplicate; to reproduce
definitions.explanation: To make a copy of a document, image, or other material. A formal term for copying or reproduction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{複写|ふくしゃ}する。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{複写|ふくしゃ}→複写：19000_fukusha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧です。
examples.english: Copying of this material is prohibited.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原本|げんぽん}→原本：15697_genpon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{複写|ふくしゃ}して⟦{各部署|かくぶしょ}→各部署：29114_kakubusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配|くば}った→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: I copied the original and distributed it to each department.

notes:
A formal term for copying or reproducing documents and materials. Often seen in legal and administrative contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{複写|ふくしゃ}→複写：19000_fukusha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: copying prohibited
- ⟦{複写|ふくしゃ}{機|き}→複写機：24248_fukushaki⟧: copier, copying machine
- ⟦{複写|ふくしゃ}→複写：19000_fukusha⟧⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧: copy paper, carbon paper
- ⟦{無断|むだん}→無断：13382_mudan⟧⟦{複写|ふくしゃ}→複写：19000_fukusha⟧: unauthorized copying
- ⟦{複写|ふくしゃ}→複写：19000_fukusha⟧{権|けん}: reproduction rights

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦コピーする→コピーする：02941_kopiisuru⟧: to copy — everyday loanword, most common in conversation
- ⟦{複製|ふくせい}→複製：17528_fukusei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to reproduce, to replicate — also formal, broader (includes manufacturing)
- ⟦{写|うつ}す→写す：01227_utsusu⟧: to copy by hand — implies manual transcription
- ⟦{模写|もしゃ}→模写：19473_mosha⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to copy (artwork) — specifically for art reproduction

REGISTER:
More formal than ⟦コピーする→コピーする：02941_kopiisuru⟧. Commonly found on copyright notices, library signs, and official documents. In everyday speech, ⟦コピーする→コピーする：02941_kopiisuru⟧ is preferred.
